entry.title: Jessica Mauboy - While I Got Time (Live at Sunrise | Powered by TikTok LIVE )

media:group.media:title: Jessica Mauboy - While I Got Time (Live at Sunrise | Powered by TikTok LIVE )
media:group.media:description:
Listen on your preferred platform https://jessicamauboy.ffm.to/whileigottime
Guitar: Darryl Beaton Backing Vocals: Hannah Agum, Laura Stitt Label: Jamally | Distro Direct Management: www.artizanx.com
Lyrics: Jessica Mauboy | PJ Harding (Universal Publishing)
The pictures on the wall Are whispering my name They’re holding on to stories That no longer have a place
It’s easy losing hope When you're counting down the days But I’ll step into the great unknown With only love and grace
So while I still got time I’ll pick flowers in my mind I’ll be dancing with the embers as they’re rising
Oh while I Still got time And there’s wonders left to find I’ll be somewhere out there over the horizon While I got time While I got time
The wind is blowing now It’s pushing at my back The sand under my feet It’s slipping through this hour glass
And I never wanna leave But I know that I can’t stay And there’s a world beyond the ocean That is calling me away
So while still got time I’ll pick flowers in mind I’ll be dancing with the embers as they’re rising
Oh while I Still got time And there’s wonders left to find I’ll be somewhere out there over the horizon While I got time While I got time
No this is not goodbye it’s not the end it’s Till we meet again Just step into the water And I’ll always be standing Right there with you
So while still got time I’ll pick flowers in my mind I’ll be dancing with the embers as they’re rising
Oh while I Still got time And there’s wonders left to find I’ll be somewhere out there over the horizon While I got time While I got time
#JessicaMauboy #NewMusic
